reference.package: fumadocs-ui 16.19.7 (npm, MIT, Copyright (c) 2023 Fuma): css/neutral.css, css/lib/default-colors.css, css/lib/base.css, css/lib/shiki.css and dist/tailwind/typography.js are the tokens, the base, the code rules and the typography of the stylesheet

live.why: The layout the live documentation shows is the `spacious` layout (`#fd-spacious-layout`), which no released version of fumadocs-ui contains (16.19.7 and 17.0.0 have the docs, flux, glass, home and notebook layouts): its markup and classes are read from the live pages, and where the package and the live pages differ the live pages win.

additions: the `layout` variant of the spacious layout (`#fd-spacious-layout:has(> &, > * > &, > * > * > &)`), which the live stylesheet defines and the package's base.css defines for the other layouts
the animation `fd-roll-in`, which the live stylesheet defines and the package lacks
the typefaces: `--font-sans` is Inter and `--font-mono` is JetBrains Mono, where the live documentation sets its own (Geist)
departures: the reading area of the light theme is white (`--color-fd-background: #ffffff` in src/theme/site.css), where the reference's is `#f5f5f5` (the owner's decision of 2026-11-22)

the accent is the reference's neutral grayscale (`--color-fd-primary` is near black in the light theme and near white in the dark), where the live documentation sets a blue of its own for its current item and its links (the owner's decision of 2026-11-22: the neutral grayscale)
the code themes are the reference's default pair, Catppuccin Latte and Mocha (Shiki), and SQL, which the library lang-sql reads better than Shiki's grammar, uses the same palettes
noEquivalent: badges (a small label with a coloured dot): drawn with the classes of the reference's `kbd` and secondary button and its tone colours
tiles of the first page (`stats`): drawn with the reference's card
trend lines: drawn in `text-fd-primary` with a caption in the muted colour
the entries of the API and of the specifications: a card with a header row, the signature as a code block and the description
diagrams: a card around the drawing, drawn in the tokens, with its source in a disclosure
the filter above a table: the reference's search field, in the classes of its search button
the selector of the sections: the reference's selector of root folders, whose menu is the reference's popover menu, placed by a script
the lozenge that follows the pointer in the side navigation: the reference's, moved by a script of the site
the scrollbar of the side navigation: hidden, as the reference's is, with no overlay thumb
tool: tools/fumadocs-css.mjs, run by hand; it is not a dependency of the library, of its package or of its build
